title: Machine-guided path sampling to discover mechanisms of molecular self-organization
summary: Trajectory and committor analyses identify a temperature-dependent switch in the importance of cage formation to hydrate growth within the simulated model. The mechanism is supported in the studied computational model; experimental generality was not demonstrated.
ai_technology: A neural committor guides rare-event path sampling and symbolic regression derives a mechanistic expression for methane-hydrate self-organization.
